Implemented the items count endpoint. Here's what was done:

**Changes:**

1. **Added `/items/count` endpoint** (backend/app/api/routes/items.py:13-27)
   - Returns `{"count": <int>}` with the number of items owned by the current user
   - Superusers see total count of all items
   - Normal users see only their own items count

2. **Added tests** (backend/tests/api/routes/test_items.py)
   - `test_get_items_count`: Verifies superusers get all items count
   - `test_get_items_count_normal_user`: Verifies normal users get only their own items count
